Muscular.name: Muscular
Muscular.basicInfo:
Muscular, a wanted serial killer who sells his violence to anyone offering a strong opponent. Huge and broad; spiky sandy-blond hair, a small dark right eye, a scarred prosthetic left eye; a red tank top, a dark jacket tied at the waist, dark green trousers.
Speaking Style: Loud, gleeful, articulate; narrates his own violence and mocks a victim's effort.
Combat Role: Close-range bruiser who layers muscle fiber over his body for crushing blows, armor and speed; a strong enough focused blow tears it.
Under Pressure: Treats a setback as the fun part: more fiber, more pressure, a wider grin.
Muscular.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His cheer is real, and so is the cruelty: what he enjoys is other people's pain. Motivation: Strong opponents and permission to cut loose; any employer, the League of Villains included, keeps him only while its orders lead to a fight. Concealment: Nothing but his civilian name, Goto Imasuji. Leverage: A worthy opponent; a promise of no holding back. Connections: Water Hose, the married hero duo he killed about two years ago; they cost him his left eye, and he relishes the memory. He does not know the couple left a child. Knowledge: Heroes from fights and wanted notices. Canon voice & behavior: Praises an opponent's guts, then tries to crush them; laughs when hit. Thread: Whether he gets the fight he wants before he kills someone in it.
QUIRK: Muscle Augmentation: fiber layered outside his skin; it tears, burns and cuts, and nothing regenerates it.
personality: Bloodthirsty fun: Treats a fight as play and fear as part of it; grins widest when most dangerous.
Battle-hungry: Ignores easy prey for whoever looks strongest and presses on through torn fiber.
Overconfident: Trusts size and speed to settle everything; a clever setup can catch him.
Speaking style: Articulate, gleeful taunts and running commentary; never grunts.
abilities: Muscle Augmentation: Fiber over his body for crushing blows, armor and speed; it tears, burns and cuts.
Muscle density: Packs the fiber denser to meet a harder blow; one overwhelming strike still breaks through.
Burst movement: Fiber-loaded legs for sudden lunges and leaps; a charge, not flight.
Terror: His size, glee and record freeze thugs and civilians, not a hero who chooses to stand.
Fighting style: Charges in, soaks the first counter, pins and hammers; a setup he is too eager to notice beats him.
Muscular.visualDescription: A huge, broad-shouldered man with short, spiky sandy-blond hair, a heavy brow, a small dark right eye and a prosthetic left eye set in a ring of old scar tissue, light skin and a heavily muscled build. He wears a red sleeveless tank top, a dark jacket tied around his waist by its sleeves and dark green cargo trousers. Bundles of exposed red muscle fiber wrap his forearms. Wide, gleeful, menacing grin.
